This scene:
一天，很久很久以前，孟子和他妈妈住在中国。孟子妈妈的工作是祭拜，孟子不高兴，因为他说我们老是搬家，为什么？他妈妈说，从早到晚，我一直祭拜，很多墓地得我祭拜。所以我们得去很多不同的地方。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 一天，很久很久以前，孟子和他妈妈住在中国：delete一天；better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
- 孟子妈妈的工作是祭拜：wrong information, it’s not his mother’s job
- 孟子不高兴，因为他说我们老是搬家：delete因为

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 一天，很久很久以前：很久很久以前的一天，A time expression that modifies “day” should come before it and link with “的.” [rule: time_expression]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 他说我们老是搬家，为什么？：他说：“我们老是搬家，为什么？”，Direct speech needs a colon after the speaking verb and quotation marks around the exact words spoken. [rule: none]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 他妈妈说，从早到晚，我一直祭拜，很多墓地得我祭拜。所以我们得去很多不同的地方。：他妈妈说：“从早到晚，我一直祭拜。我得去很多墓地祭拜，所以我们得去很多不同的地方。”，Direct speech needs quotation punctuation; also, the modal verb “得” must follow its subject and come before the action verb, so “我得去……” expresses “I have to go to…”. [rule: none]

items.reason: “一天，很久很久以前” combines the time expressions awkwardly, while “很久很久以前的一天” is correct.
The original can be read as unquoted reported speech, so adding quotation marks is not a necessary correction.
“很多墓地得我祭拜” has incorrect modal-verb word order, and “我得去很多墓地祭拜” correctly expresses the intended meaning.
